test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

In Egypt, the sun is warm on the green palm-trees, and the crocodiles lie in the mud and look lazily about them. My companions are building a nest in the Temple of Baalbec, and the pink and white doves are watching them, and cooing to each other. Dear Prince, I must leave you, but I will never forget you, and next spring I will bring you back two beautiful jewels in place of those you have given away. The ruby shall be redder than a red rose, and the sapphire shall be ______ the great sea.
solution:
The correct answer is **"as blue as."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is describing the color of a sapphire that will be brought back as a gift.
 
• The phrase **"as blue as"** is a simile that compares the color of the sapphire to the great sea.
 
• The use of **"as"** in a simile indicates a comparison between two things.
 
• The sentence structure is parallel, with both the ruby and sapphire being described using **"shall be"** followed by an adjective.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
